post.title: What Happens If You Never Pay Into Social Security?
post.ig:
Never pay into Social Security, and your retirement check is $0.
You need 40 work credits (max 4 a year). One credit took $1,890 of taxed pay in 2026.
The fallback, SSI, maxed out at $994 a month in 2026 versus a $2,071 average retiree check.
The surprise: with under 30 credits, Medicare Part A cost $565 a month in 2026. That's $6,780 a year.
Sources: SSA, CMS.
